description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Web and domain checks] The link-check for up to 10 URLs in one paid call (comma-separated): for each, alive or dead with the reason, final URL after redirects, redirect chain, cross-domain / HTTPS-downgrade flags, content type and TLS. robots.txt is checked before each URL and redirect is requested. ~1-6 s.

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.
